title: Constitutional economics
source: Writing in 1987 for the Yale Law School, Jonathan Macey synthesizes the history of constitutional economic analysis applied to the US Constitution. Macey offers a different analysis of the US Constitution and responds critically to Beard's view of the Constitution.
translation: 1987年，乔纳森·梅西为耶鲁法学院撰文，综合梳理了应用于美国宪法的宪法经济分析史。梅西对美国宪法提出了不同的分析，并对比尔德的宪法观进行了批判性回应。
